newsitem.title: USA: Group says opposes Liberty, Hinsdale deal.
newsitem.headline: Group says opposes Liberty, Hinsdale deal.

text.p: TGF Investments LP said Thursday it sent a letter to shareholders of Hinsdale Financial Corp asking them to withhold support of a proposed merger with Liberty Bancorp.

"The merits of this proposal are extremely modest and are far outweighed by the deal's detriments. Clearly there are strategic alternatives to enhance shareholder value that management should instead explore, and this deal is not one of them," said Thomas Fitzgerald, managing partner of TGF, a private investment group.
Fitzgerald said he has been in touch with other shareholders who told him they plan to vote against the deal.
If the merger proposal is defeated, Hinsdale would be free to pursue a sale of the company, he said.
TGF is a private investment firm specializing in bank and thrift stock invesments.
Hinsdale and Liberty had agreed to merge in a transaction that will create a $1.3 billion asset bank holding company.
